title: Government deploys 20 trial buses to ease LRT-2 morning rush congestion
summary: DOTr Secretary Vince Dizon led an inspection at the LRT-2 Antipolo Station on Wednesday, announcing the immediate rollout of a 20-bus trial run to relieve severe commuter bottlenecks along the line.
